about: The compiler says he found how he was born written in that book, and that the evangelists mention this woman: the Queen of the South will rise on the day of judgment against that generation (Matthew 12:42, Luke 11:31), for she came from the ends of the earth to hear Solomon's wisdom; she is the queen of Ethiopia, beautiful, wise and rich, with traders by sea and land. Chapter 22 introduces Tamrin, her chief merchant, with 520 camels and 73 ships, whom Solomon, building the house of God, sends for goods from Arabia; Tamrin goes to Solomon, marvels at his wisdom, justice and gentleness, and the chapter closes on the riches and wisdom God gave Solomon, beyond all kings before or after.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፳፩ is the numeral 20 + 1 = 21. በእንተ 'concerning' governs ንግሥተ 'queen of' (ንግሥት, construct state before the next noun) and አዜብ 'south'; አዜብ 'south' matches the 'queen of the south' of Matthew 12:42 and Luke 11:31 (I have not checked the spelling in the Geʿez Gospels). The text here never says Sheba, and no earlier part of this book names her; the traditional identification of the Gospels' queen with the queen of Sheba of 1 Kings 10 is not made in these two chapters, and the rendering stays with 'South'.

sentences.l: Queen-of South she-will-rise on day-of judgment and-she-will-reproach-them and-she-will-contend-with-them and-she-will-overcome-them, to-this generation who not they-heard preaching-of word-my;
sentences.i: 'The Queen of the South will rise up on the day of judgment, and she will reproach them and contend with them and overcome them — this generation, who did not hear the preaching of my word;
sentences.n: The allusion is Matthew 12:42 and Luke 11:31: 'The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation and shall condemn it.' Here Christ's words are expanded by three verbs, all 3fs imperfect with ወ-: ትትነሣእ 'she will rise' (ተነሥአ 'rise up'), ወትትዋቀሦሙ 'she will reproach them' (the reciprocal ተ- stem of ወቀሠ), ወትትፋትሖሙ 'she will contend with them' (ተፋትሐ, from ፈትሐ 'judge, loose'; 'go to law with'), ወትመውኦሙ 'she will overcome them' (መውአ 'conquer'). Dillmann is unavailable here, so the senses of the last three are unconfirmed; the force 'she will condemn' is what the Gospels say. አመ ዕለተ ኰነኔ 'on the day of judgment' (ዕለተ construct 'day of'). ለዛቲ ትውልድ ('this generation', feminine demonstrative with a feminine noun) stands in apposition to ሙ 'them'. ስብከተ ቃልየ 'the preaching of my word' (ቃል + -የ 'my').

sentences.i: for she herself came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon'; and the one he called 'Queen of the South' is the queen of Ethiopia;
sentences.n: Luke 11:31 (compare Matthew 12:42): she 'came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon.' ለሊሃ 'she herself' (emphatic). መጽአት 'she came' (3fs perfect). እምአጽናፈ ምድር: እም- 'from' + አጽናፈ 'ends of' (construct plural of ጽንፍ). ከመ ትስማዕ 'that she might hear' (jussive). ጥበቢሁ ለሰሎሞን 'his wisdom, Solomon's' — a suffix anticipating the possessor named with ለ-, a pattern that recurs (ch. 17 heading, ch. 1). ወዘይቤ: ወ- + ዘ- 'that which' + ይቤ 'he said', that is, Christ's phrase. ንግሥተ ኢትዮጵያ ይእቲ 'queen of Ethiopia she (is)': the copula ይእቲ follows the predicate.

sentences.l: And-ends-of earth-as-for that-which-it-was-said on-account-of weakness-of nature of-women and-on-account-of length-of road and-flame-of sun and-on-account-of hunger-of road and-thirst-of water ፨
sentences.i: And as for 'the ends of the earth', what was said there is on account of the weakness of the female nature, and the length of the road, and the burning of the sun, and on account of the hunger of the road and the thirst for water.
sentences.n: The narrator explains why the Gospel speaks of the 'ends of the earth': the journey was long and hard. ወአጽናፈ ምድርሰ: enclitic -ሰ 'as for'. ዘተብህለ 'that which was said' (ተብህለ, passive of ብህለ 'say'); the sentence has no main verb, 'what was said (is) for …'. Five reasons are linked by ወበእንተ 'and on account of': ድካመ 'weakness of' (construct of ድካም) ፍጥረት ዘአንስት 'nature of women' (ዘ- as a genitive; አንስት is the plural of ብእሲት); ርሕቀ ፍኖት 'distance of the road' (ርሕቀ construct); ላህበ ፀሐይ 'flame of the sun' (ላህብ 'flame, burning heat'); ረኃበ ፍኖት 'hunger of the road'; ጽምአ ማይ 'thirst of water'. ፨ closes the unit.

sentences.i: As for the Queen of the South, she was very beautiful in appearance and in comeliness, and in the knowledge and understanding that God gave her, so that she might go to Jerusalem to hear the wisdom of Solomon;
sentences.n: ወይእቲሰ 'and she, as for her' (ወ- + pronoun + -ሰ, contrastive). ሠናይት ጥቀ 'good, beautiful, very' (fem. adjective; ጥቀ 'very'). በራእያኒ በላሕያኒ: a doubled በ- 'in' with enclitic -ኒ on each, 'both in appearance and in comeliness'; ራእይ 'appearance, sight', ላሕይ 'beauty, comeliness' (the second is read from context and from ላሕዩ 'his beauty' in ch. 22; not confirmed). ዘወሀባ 'which he gave her' (ዘ- + ወሀበ + -ኣ 'her'). ከመ ትሖር 'that she go' (ሖረ 'go', 3fs, after ከመ); Jerusalem is the accusative of place, with no preposition.

sentences.i: For this was done by the will of God, and it was his good pleasure; and she was very rich in what God had given her — glory and wealth, gold and silver, precious garments, camels, servants and merchants — and they trade for her by sea and by land, and in India(?) and Aswan.
sentences.n: ተገብረ ዝንቱ 'this was done' (ተገብረ, passive of ገብረ 'do, make'); ወኮነ ሥምረቱ 'and it was his pleasure' (ሥምረት 'good pleasure', from ሠምረ). በፈቃደ 'by the will of' (construct). ባዕልት 'rich' (fem.). ወህባ is a spelling of ወሀባ 'he gave her' (as in unit 8). The accusative list ክብረ ወብዕለ ወርቀ ወብሩረ … (the accusative ending -ä) stands in apposition to ዘ 'what'. ወይነግዱ ላቲ: 3mpl imperfect of ነገደ 'trade', with ላቲ 'for her' (ለ- with the 3fs suffix); the subject of ወይነግዱ 'they trade' is the merchants (ነጋድያነ) just named in the list. ባሕረ ወየብሰ 'sea and dry land', accusatives of place: 'by sea and by land'. ህንደኬ I take as a place, India(?): it is not the ህንድ 'India' of ch. 20, and it has the same spelling as the Ethiopic Bible's name for the Candace of Acts 8:27 (from memory of the Geʿez Bible, unchecked), but the trade context and the parallel ወአስዋነ 'Aswan' (Syene, in the south of Egypt, accusative -ነ) favour the place, as given. ፨ ፨ closes the chapter.

sentences.i: There was a prudent man, chief of merchants, whose name was Tamrin, who loaded 520 camels, and he had ships as well, as many as 73. And Solomon the king, at that time, wished to build the house of God, and sent word to all the merchants, east and west, south and north, that the merchants should come and take from him gold and silver, and that he, for his part, would take what was needed for the work; and they told him about that Ethiopian merchant, a rich man, and he sent that he should bring him what was needed from the land of Arabia — red gold, and black wood that does not rot, and sapphire.
sentences.n: The unit runs to about 62 words with no ፤ in it, and it ends at the ። the source gives here, so it is longer than the ~45-word rule allows. ወሀለወ 'and there was/existed'; ፩ is the numeral 1 ('one', here 'a certain'); ልብው 'prudent, wise'; ሊቀ ነጋድያን 'chief of merchants' (ሊቀ construct); ዘስሙ 'whose name'. ወይጽዕን 'and he loads' (ጸዐነ 'carry, load', 3ms imperfect, said of one who loads 520 camels, an owner of caravans); ፭፻ ወ፳ is 500 and 20 = 520, ፸ወ፫ is 70 and 3 = 73 (ወ between numerals is 'and'). ወአሕማረኒ ቦቱ 'and ships too (አሕማር, plural of ሐመር) were with him, he had', with መጠነ 'to the measure of, as many as'. Solomon's building of the Temple (1 Kings 5–6; 2 Chronicles 2) is the setting. ወለአከ 'and he sent' (ለአከ, the same verb as ወለአከ later in the unit). ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን ለምሥራቅ … 'among all the merchants, to the east, to the west, to the south and to the north' (the four directions with ለ-). ወይንሥኡ በኀቤሁ ወርቀ ወብሩረ: I read በኀቤሁ as 'from him' and ይንሥኡ 'they take' (jussive), which is uncertain; another reading is 'take (it) to him' (as ኀቤሁ means 'to him' elsewhere). ዘይትፈቀድ 'what is needed' (passive imperfect of ፈቀደ, 'what is wished/required'); ለግብር 'for the work'. ወነገርዎ 'and they told him'. ከመ ያምጽእ ሎቱ 'that he bring him' (አምጽአ, the causative of መጽአ). ብሔረ ዐረብ 'land of the Arabs/Arabia'. ቀዪሐ 'red' (accusative of ቀይሕ); ዘኢይነቅዝ ጸሊመ 'which does not rot, black' — the black wood that does not rot is perhaps ebony (my inference). ሰንፔረ 'sapphire' (a loanword). The stray ፡ before ። is as the source has it.

sentences.i: And Solomon took from him all that he wished, and gave the merchant what he wished, abundantly, out of his own goods; and the merchant, for his part, was exceedingly prudent, and he saw the wisdom of Solomon and marvelled, and took care to examine the reply of his word, and his judgment, and the [śaʾśaʾä] of his mouth(?), and the sweetness of his speech, and his goings, and his sitting, and his rising, and his deeds, and his love, and his ordinances, and his table, and his law; and also how he commands those under him, with humility and gentleness;
sentences.n: The subject of ወነሥአ and ወወሀቦ is not marked: I read Solomon as the one who took what he wished from Tamrin and gave him, in return, what he wished, out of his goods (ንዋዩ 'his goods', ንዋይ + -ሁ); the other reading, Tamrin as the taker, is possible. አፈድፍዶ 'abundantly' (a gerund of the causative of ፈድፈደ 'increase'). ወውእቱሰ ነጋዲ 'and the merchant, for his part' (ውእቱ + -ሰ). ወይሬኢ 'and he saw' (ርእየ), here the imperfect used as a narrative past, as are ወያነክር 'and he marvelled' (አነከረ 'wonder, marvel') and ወይትዐቀብ 'and he took care'. ከመ ይጠይቅ 'that he examine' (ጠየቀ 'examine, investigate'). What follows is a list of accusatives, each with the suffix -ሁ/-ኦ 'his': አውሥኦተ ቃሉ 'the answering of his word', ፍትሖ 'his judgment', ጣዕመ ነገሩ 'the sweetness of his speech', ሑረቶ 'his goings, his conduct' (ሑረት, from ሖረ), ንብረቶ 'his sitting, his manner of living' (ንብረት), ተንሥኦቶ 'his rising' (a noun in -ት from ተነሥአ, with -ኦ; the base is inferred from the form), ግብሮ 'his deed', ፍቅሮ 'his love', ሥርዐቶ 'his ordinance', ማእዶ 'his table' (ማእድ), ሕጎ 'his law'. ሣእሣአ አፉሁ: I cannot confirm ሣእሣእ (Dillmann is unavailable here); I leave it bracketed and guess 'the [śaʾśaʾä] of his mouth' to mean something like the fitness or order of his speech, which is uncertain. ወለእለኒ 'and also those whom' (ለ- object marker + እለ + -ኒ) ይኤዝዞሙ 'he commands them' (አዘዘ 'command'); ትሕትና 'humility', የውሀት 'meekness, gentleness' (from የዋህ).

sentences.l: And-even-when they-sinned he-pities-them for with-wisdom and-with-fear-of God he-orders house-his;
sentences.i: And even when they sinned he has pity on them, for with wisdom and with the fear of God he orders his house;
sentences.n: ወሶበኒ 'and even when' (ሶበ 'when' + enclitic -ኒ). አበሱ 'they sinned' (አበሰ 'sin', 3mpl perfect; I take the initial አ as part of the root, not a causative prefix). ይምሕሮሙ 'he pities them' (ምሕረ 'have mercy, forgive', 3ms imperfect + -ሙ; spelled with ሕ, which marks this root and not ምህረ 'teach'). በፍርሀተ እግዚኣብሔር 'in the fear of God' (ፍርሀተ construct). ይሠርዕ ቤቶ 'he orders his house' (ሠርዐ 'set in order, appoint'; ቤቶ is ቤት 'house' with the 3ms suffix in its accusative form -ኦ (the nominative is ቤቱ), the object of ይሠርዕ, as with the accusatives of unit 13). Proverbs 1:7, 'the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom', may lie behind the pairing.

sentences.i: and the sweetness of his speech is like water to the thirsty, and like bread to the hungry, and like healing to the sick, and like clothing to the naked, and like a father to the orphan;
sentences.n: A run of ከመ 'like' phrases, each with ለ- 'to, for': ጽሙእ 'thirsty', ርኁብ 'hungry', ድዉይ 'sick', ዕሩቅ 'naked'. In the source ለ ርኁብ has a stray wordspace. እጓለ ማውታ 'child of the dead', the idiom for 'orphan' (ማውታ is the plural of ሙት; the construct form of እጓል is እጓለ). The sequence may recall the works of mercy of Matthew 25:35–36 (food, drink, clothing, the sick) and, in part, Isaiah 58:7 (bread for the hungry, covering the naked); the text does not quote either.

sentences.l: And-with-him glory and-wealth which he-gave-him God exceedingly, gold and-silver and-stones and-garments precious and-livestock and-wild-beasts which there-is-not number; and-in-days-his-as-for of-Solomon king it-became gold like [bərt] and-silver like bronze(?) and-[bərt]-as-for and-bronze(?) and-iron it-became plentiful like trees-of [baḥrus] and-like [bərʿä]-of wilderness and-trees-of cedar-also plentiful it-became;
sentences.i: And he had glory and wealth, which God had given him in abundance — gold and silver and gems and precious garments, and livestock and wild beasts without number. And in the days of Solomon the king gold became like [bərt] and silver like bronze(?), and as for [bərt] and bronze(?) and iron, they became as plentiful as the [baḥrus] trees and as the [bərʿä] of the wilderness, and cedar wood too became abundant;
sentences.n: The unit is about 40 words. ወቦቱ 'and with him (were)', that is, 'he had' (the preposition በ- with the 3ms suffix). ዘወሀቦ 'which he gave him'. ዕንቈ 'gems' (accusative of ዕንቍ 'gem', used collectively); ወእንስሳ 'and livestock'; ወአራዊት 'and wild beasts'; ዘአልቦ ኆልቈ 'which has no number'. ወበመዋዕሊሁሰ ለሰሎሞን ንጉሥ 'and in his days, Solomon the king's' (suffix anticipating the possessor). Compare 1 Kings 10:27 and 2 Chronicles 1:15 (silver as common as stones, cedar as sycamores). The metal and plant words are uncertain: ብርት is a rare word that I cannot confirm (a metal; I leave it bracketed); ዐረር is 'bronze' or 'brass'; ኀጺን 'iron'. ባሕሩስ (trees) and ብርዐ (of the wilderness) I cannot place; the second may be 'sand' or 'dust', which would fit the comparison, and ባሕሩስ may be a tree name, and both are bracketed. ዕፀ ቄድሮስ 'cedar wood' (ቄድሮስ from the Greek kedros); ብዙኀ ኮነ 'became abundant'.

sentences.i: by what God gave him — glory, wealth, wisdom and majesty — such that those before him were not like him, and none such as he will be after him.
sentences.n: በዘ ወሀቦ 'by that which he gave him' (በ- + ዘ- + ወሀበ + -ኦ). ሞገሰ 'majesty, favour' (accusative of ሞገስ). ዘኢኮኑ ከማሁ እለ እምቅድሜሁ 'such that those before him were not like him' (ከማሁ 'like him'; ኮኑ 3mpl perfect of ኮነ). ኢይከውኑ እምድኅሬሁ ዘከማሁ 'there will not be after him one like him' (3mpl imperfect of ኮነ). The ten ፨ at the end of the chapter close the part. The same line, about Solomon's incomparable wisdom, echoes 1 Kings 3:12 and 10:23.

glossary.ሰቃልያን: ሰቃሊ — crucifier (agent noun from ሰቀለ 'hang, crucify'; plural ሰቃልያን; the singular is inferred from the plural, Dillmann unavailable)
glossary.ቀዪሐ: ቀይሕ — red (adjective, accusative, qualifying ወርቀ; written ቀዪሐ)
glossary.ቄድሮስኒ: ቄድሮስ — cedar (noun, from Greek kedros) + enclitic -ኒ 'also, and'
glossary.በላሕያኒ: ላሕይ — in comeliness, beauty (በ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ 'both, also'; stem written ላሕያ- as in ራእያኒ) (meaning inferred from context, unconfirmed)
glossary.በራእያኒ: ራእይ — in appearance (በ- 'in' + noun ራእይ 'appearance, sight' + enclitic -ኒ 'both, also'; the stem is written ራእያ- before -ኒ, which is unexplained, Dillmann unavailable)
glossary.በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing')
glossary.በኀቤሁ: ኀበ — from him, with him (በ- + ኀቤሁ 'to him'; sense 'from him' preferred, 'to him' possible) (?)
glossary.በአምሳል: አምሳል — by likeness, in an image (በ- 'by, in' + noun)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በዘ: ዘ — in that which, by that which (በ- + relative ዘ-; 'because, in that')
glossary.በፈቃደ: ፈቃድ — by the will of (በ- 'by' + noun, construct 'will of')
glossary.ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea')
glossary.ባሕሩስ: ባሕሩስ — (?) probably a tree name; word unconfirmed
glossary.ብርት: ብርት — (?) a metal or common material; word unconfirmed (compare Amharic ብረት 'iron')
glossary.ብርዐ: ብርዐ — (?) perhaps 'sand, dust' or a plant; word unconfirmed (construct before ገዳም)
glossary.ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, abundant (adjective, masc. sg.; written ብዙኀ, adverbial/predicate)
glossary.ብዝኁ: በዝኀ — they were many, abundant (3mpl perfect, G; written ብዝኁ after ኮነ 'became'; a plural verb beside the singular ኮነ is unexplained, so reading uncertain)
glossary.ቦቱ: በ — with him, he had (preposition በ- + 3ms suffix -ቱ: ቦቱ, expressing possession)
glossary.ተምሪን: ተምሪን — Tamrin (proper name; spelling of the body of ch. 22, the heading has ታምሪን)
glossary.ተወልደሂ: ተወልደ — he was born (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ወለደ) + enclitic -ሂ 'also, too'
glossary.ተገብረ: ገብረ — it was done, made (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ታምሪን: ታምሪን — Tamrin (proper name; spelling of the chapter heading, elsewhere ተምሪን)
glossary.ትሖር: ሖረ — that she go (3fs, after ከመ; the imperfect shape ትሖር)
glossary.ትስማዕ: ሰምዐ — that she may hear (3fs subjunctive, after ከመ)
glossary.ትትነሣእ: ተነሥአ — she will rise (3fs imperfect, tä-stem, 'rise up')
glossary.ትትፈቀር: ተፈቀረ — she is loved (3fs imperfect, tä-stem passive of ፈቀረ; ጥበብ is fem.)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings)
glossary.ኆልቈ: ኆልቍ — number, count (noun, accusative ኆልቈ; ዘአልቦ ኆልቈ 'without number')
glossary.ነገሩ: ነገር — his speech, word, matter (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ነጋዲ: ነጋዲ — merchant, trader (noun; agent noun of ነገደ; plural ነጋድያን)
glossary.ነጋዲሃ: ነጋዲ — her merchant (noun + -ሃ '3fs her'; the suffix anticipates the possessor named with ለ-)
glossary.ነጋድያን: ነጋዲ — merchants (noun, plural of ነጋዲ; as in ሊቀ ነጋድያን 'chief of merchants')
glossary.ንግሥተ: ንግሥት — queen (noun, fem.; construct 'queen of' before the following noun)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of (preposition + construct: አመ ዕለተ 'on the day of'); when
glossary.አብ: አብ — father (the Father) · a father in general (በረከተ አብ ላዕለ ወልድ)
glossary.አውሥኦተ: አውሥኦት — answering, reply (verbal noun of አውሥአ, construct 'answering of'; accusative)
glossary.አዜብ: አዜብ — south (noun; the dependent noun after the construct ንግሥተ, 'of the south')
glossary.አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ)
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible
glossary.አግማለ: ገመል — camels (plural አግማል, accusative; object of ይጽዕን)
glossary.አፈድፍዶ: አፈድፈደ — abundantly, with increase (gerund, 3ms, causative of ፈድፈደ, used adverbially)
glossary.አፉሁ: አፍ — his mouth (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; the stem is አፉ- before the suffix)
glossary.ኢሰምዑ: ሰምዐ — they did not hear (ኢ- negative + 3mpl perfect)
glossary.ኢይፈቅዱ: ፈቀደ — they do not wish (ኢ- negative + 3mpl imperfect, G)
glossary.እምቅድሜሁ: ቅድሜ — before him (እም- + noun 'front' + -ሁ '3ms his'; እምቅድሜሁ 'those before him')
glossary.እምብሔረ: ብሔር — from the land of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምንዋዩ: ንዋይ — from his goods (እም- 'from' + noun 'goods, vessels' + -ሁ '3ms his', ንዋዩ)
glossary.እምአጽናፈ: ጽንፍ — from the ends of (እም- 'from' + plural አጽናፍ, construct)
glossary.እምጸቃውዐ: ጸቃውዕ — honeycomb(?) (እም- 'than' + noun, construct 'honeycomb of'; the word is not confirmed, the sense taken from the context and Psalm 19:10; Dillmann unavailable)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16)
glossary.ክቡረ: ክቡር — precious, honoured (adjective, accusative, qualifying አልባሰ)
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ኵለንታሁ: ኵለንታ — all of him, his whole self (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of
glossary.ወሀለወ: ሀለወ — and there was, there existed (ወ- + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
glossary.ወህባ: ወሀበ — and he gave her (3ms perfect + -ኣ 3fs object; spelled with ህ for ሀ, the ወ- 'and' is part of the verb's w-h-b root, not a proclitic here)
glossary.ወህንደኬ: ህንደኬ — and India(?) (ወ- + proper name, accusative; taken as a place parallel to Aswan, not the ህንድ of ch. 20; the same spelling is the Candace of Acts 8:27 from memory, so a person is not excluded; Dillmann unavailable, unconfirmed)
glossary.ወለምዕራብ: ምዕራብ — and to the west (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' + noun)
glossary.ወለሰሜን: ሰሜን — and to the north (ወ- + ለ- + noun)
glossary.ወለአከ: ለአከ — and he sent (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወለእለኒ: እለ — and also those whom (ወ- + ለ- object marker + relative pronoun pl. + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወላህበ: ላህብ — and the flame, burning heat of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወላሕዩ: ላሕይ — and his comeliness, beauty (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his') (meaning inferred from context)
glossary.ወሑረቶ: ሑረት — and his goings, conduct (ወ- + verbal noun of ሖረ + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ወሕጎ: ሕግ — and his law (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወመምህር: መምህር — and teacher (ወ- + noun, agent noun of ምህረ 'teach')
glossary.ወማእዶ: ማእድ — and his table (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ወሞገሰ: ሞገስ — and majesty, favour, grace (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወሣእሣአ: ሣእሣአ — and the [śaʾśaʾä] of(?) (ወ- + unidentified noun, accusative or construct, lemma not established; sense unknown, perhaps something like order or fitness of speech; Dillmann unavailable)
glossary.ወርቅ: ወርቅ — gold (noun; ንዋየ ወርቅ 'vessels of gold')
glossary.ወሰንፔረ: ሰንፔር — and sapphire (ወ- + loanword noun, accusative)
glossary.ወበመዋዕሊሁሰ: መዋዕል — and in his days (ወ- + በ- 'in' + plural of ዕለት + -ሁ '3ms his' + enclitic -ሰ 'as for')
glossary.ወበአእምሮ: አእምሮ — and in knowledge, understanding (ወ- + በ- + noun, verbal noun of አእመረ)
glossary.ወበፍርሀተ: ፍርሀት — and in the fear of (ወ- + በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወብርትሰ: ብርት — and as for [ብርት] (ወ- + noun + contrastive -ሰ) (?) word unconfirmed
glossary.ወብዕለ: ብዕል — and riches, wealth (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወቦቱ: በ — and with it (ወ- + preposition በ- with 3ms suffix ቦቱ) · 'and with him (were)', i.e. 'he had' (possession, ወቦቱ ክብረ ወብዕለ 'and he had glory and riches')
glossary.ወተንሥኦቶ: ተንሥኦት — and his rising (ወ- + noun in -ት from ተነሥአ + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative; the base ተንሥኦት is inferred from the form, as with ሑረቶ, and the dictionary may give ተንሥኦ; Dillmann unavailable)
glossary.ወትመውኦሙ: መውአ — and she will overcome them (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G, 'conquer' + -ሙ 3mpl) (sense unconfirmed)
glossary.ወትትሜነን: ተመነነ — and she is scorned, rejected (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, tä-stem passive) (sense from context, unconfirmed)
glossary.ወትትዋቀሦሙ: ተዋቀሠ — and she will reproach them (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, reciprocal tä-stem of ወቀሠ + -ሙ 3mpl) (sense unconfirmed)
glossary.ወትትፋትሖሙ: ተፋትሐ — and she will contend with them (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, tä-stem reciprocal of ፈትሐ 'judge' + -ሙ 3mpl) (sense unconfirmed)
glossary.ወነሥአ: ነሥአ — and he took (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወነገርዎ: ነገረ — and they told him (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, G + -ዎ 3ms object)
glossary.ወነጋድያነ: ነጋዲ — and merchants (ወ- + plural ነጋድያን, accusative)
glossary.ወንብረቶ: ንብረት — and his sitting, manner of life (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ወአልባሰ: ልብስ — and garments (ወ- + plural አልባስ, accusative)
glossary.ወአሕማረኒ: ሐመር — and ships also (ወ- + plural አሕማር in the accusative, አሕማረ, + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአራዊት: አርዌ — and wild beasts (ወ- + plural አራዊት)
glossary.ወአስዋነ: አስዋን — and Aswan, Syene (ወ- + place name, accusative -ä)
glossary.ወአግማለ: ገመል — and camels (ወ- + plural አግማል, accusative)
glossary.ወአግብርተ: ገብር — and servants (ወ- + plural አግብርት, accusative)
glossary.ወአጽናፈ: ጽንፍ — and the ends of (ወ- + plural አጽናፍ, construct)
glossary.ወኢያደሉ: አደለወ — and he does not incline (ወ- + ኢ- negative + 3ms imperfect, causative 'incline, weigh')
glossary.ወኢይከውኑ: ኮነ — and they will not be (ወ- + ኢ- negative + 3mpl imperfect)
glossary.ወእለኒ: እለ — and those also (ወ- + relative pronoun pl. + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
glossary.ወእግዚእነሂ: እግዚእ — and our lord also (ወ- + noun + -ነ '1pl our' + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — and that (ወ- 'and' + conjunction) · and like, and as (ወ- + ከመ 'like, as' before a noun: ወከመ ፈውስ ለድዉይ 'and like healing to the sick')
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix)
glossary.ወወሀቦ: ወሀበ — and he gave him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-h-b + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዕንቈ: ዕንቍ — and gems, precious stones (ወ- + noun ዕንቍ in the accusative, collective)
glossary.ወዕፀ: ዕፅ — and wood, tree (ወ- + noun: accusative in ወዕፀ ዘኢይነቅዝ ጸሊመ 'and wood that does not rot, black', construct 'wood of' in ወዕፀ ቄድሮስኒ 'and cedar wood')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘከመ: ዘከመ — and how, in the way that (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ, ዘ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወዘይቤ: ብህለ — and what he said (ወ- + ዘ- 'that which' + ይቤ 3ms perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ወየብሰ: የብስ — and dry land (ወ- + noun, accusative of place 'by land')
glossary.ወየውሀት: የውሀት — and meekness, gentleness (ወ- + noun, from የዋህ)
glossary.ወያነክር: አነከረ — and he marvelled (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative, 'wonder, marvel'; narrative use)
glossary.ወያክሞስሶሙ: ያክሞስሶሙ — and he deals with them(?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect with ያ- + -ሙ 3mpl object; verb not identified, root and sense unconfirmed, the manner given by በየውሀት 'with gentleness'; Dillmann unavailable)
glossary.ወይሤርሖን: ሠርሐ — and he arranges them (f.) (?) (ወ- + 3ms imperfect + -ሖን 3fp object; sense 'make ready, set in order' unconfirmed)
glossary.ወይሬኢ: ርእየ — and he saw (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, used as a narrative past)
glossary.ወይትዐቀብ: ተዐቀበ — and he took care, observed (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem; narrative use)
glossary.ወይትገሐሡ: ተገሕሠ — and that they draw back (ወ- + 3mpl subjunctive, tä-stem, 'withdraw')
glossary.ወይነግዱ: ነገደ — and they trade (ወ- + 3mpl imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይንሥኡ: ነሥአ — and that they take (ወ- + 3mpl subjunctive, G)
glossary.ወይእቲሰ: ይእቲ — and she, as for her (ወ- + fem. pronoun + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወይከሥት: ከሠተ — and he opens (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይጥዕም: ጠዐመ — and it is sweet (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, 'taste, be sweet')
glossary.ወይጽዕን: ጸዐነ — and he loads, carries (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይፈትሕ: ፈትሐ — and he judges, sets free (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, f-t-ḥ)
glossary.ወግብሮ: ግብር — and his deed (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ወጣዕመ: ጣዕም — and sweetness of (ወ- + noun, construct, accusative)
glossary.ወጽምአ: ጽምእ — and thirst of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወፍቅሮ: ፍቅር — and his love (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ወፍትሖ: ፍትሕ — and his judgment (ወ- + noun + -ኦ '3ms his', accusative)
glossary.ወ፳: ፳ — and 20, with ወ- 'and': spoken ወዕሥራ (wä-ʿəśra) 'and twenty' (፭፻ ወ፳ = 520; numeral)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants')
glossary.ውስቴቱ: ውስተ — within it, in it (preposition ውስተ, stem ውስቴ- + 3ms suffix -ቱ)
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
glossary.ዐረብ: ዐረብ — Arabs, Arabia (noun; the dependent noun after the construct ብሔረ)
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem.; construct 'day of'; plural መዋዕል)
glossary.ዘስሙ: ስም — whose name (ዘ- relative + noun 'name' + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ዘተብህለ: ተብህለ — which was said (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect passive of ብህለ)
glossary.ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
glossary.ዘአንስት: ብእሲት — of women (ዘ- 'of', the relative used as a genitive linker, + plural አንስት of ብእሲት)
glossary.ዘኢኮኑ: ኮነ — which were not (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative + 3mpl perfect)
glossary.ዘኢይነቅዝ: ነቀዘ — which does not rot (ዘ- relative + ኢ- negative + 3ms imperfect, n-q-z 'be worm-eaten, decay')
glossary.ዘከማሁ: ከማሁ — one like him (ዘ- relative + ከማሁ 'like him')
glossary.ዘከርዋ: ዘከረ — they mentioned her (3mpl perfect, G, 'remember, mention' + -ዋ 3fs object suffix)
glossary.ዘወሀባ: ወሀበ — which he gave her (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኣ 3fs object suffix)
glossary.ዘወሀቦ: ወሀበ — which he gave him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object)
glossary.ዘይትፈቀድ: ተፈቀደ — what is needed, required (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect passive of ፈቀደ)
glossary.ዘይፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — what he wishes (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — what he wished (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ያምጽእ: አምጽአ — that he bring (3ms subjunctive, causative of መጽአ, after ከመ)
glossary.ያስተዐጽብ: አስተዐጸበ — he marvelled, was astonished (3ms imperfect, ʾastä-stem; narrative use) (sense unconfirmed)
glossary.ይሕንጽ: ሐነጸ — that he build (3ms subjunctive, G, after ከመ)
glossary.ይምሕሮሙ: ምሕረ — he pities, forgives them (3ms imperfect, G, 'have mercy' + -ሙ 3mpl object)
glossary.ይምጽኡ: መጽአ — that they come (3mpl subjunctive, after ከመ)
glossary.ይሠርዕ: ሠርዐ — he orders, sets in order (3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ይሬእይዎ: ርእየ — they see him (3mpl imperfect, G + -ዎ 3ms object)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይንሣእ: ነሥአ — that he take (3ms subjunctive, G)
glossary.ይኤዝዞሙ: አዘዘ — he commands them (3ms imperfect, G + -ሙ 3mpl object)
glossary.ይእትቱ: ይእትቱ — that they leave (?) (3mpl, presumably subjunctive; root not identified, sense inferred from the pairing with ይትገሐሡ; unconfirmed)
glossary.ይወቅሦሙ: ወቀሠ — he rebukes them (3ms imperfect, G, 'blame, rebuke' + -ሙ 3mpl object), after እንዘ 'while'
glossary.ይጠይቅ: ጠየቀ — that he examine, investigate (3ms subjunctive, after ከመ)
glossary.ጥበቢሁ: ጥበብ — his wisdom (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his'; the suffix anticipates the possessor named with ለ-)
glossary.ጸሊመ: ጸሊም — black, dark (adjective, accusative, qualifying ዕፀ)
glossary.ጽሑፍ: ጽሑፍ — written; a writing (passive participle, noun)
glossary.ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man')
glossary.፭፻: ፭፻ — 500, spoken ሐምስቱ ምእት (ḥämsətu məʾət) 'five hundred' (numeral)
glossary.፳፩: ፳፩ — 21, spoken ዕሥራ ወአሐዱ (ʿəśra wä-ʾäḥädu) 'twenty and one'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፳፪: ፳፪ — 22, spoken ዕሥራ ወክልኤቱ (ʿəśra wä-kəlʾetu) 'twenty and two'; chapter number (numeral)
glossary.፸ወ፫: ፸ወ፫ — 73, spoken ሰብዓ ወሠለስቱ (säbʿa wä-śälästu) 'seventy and three' (numeral)
